title: Non-reentrant time function used (c)
description: The code formats time with ctime. These functions return a pointer into a shared static buffer, so two threads calling them concurrently can each print the other's timestamp, hiding a data race behind an innocuous log line.
remediation: Use the reentrant variant that writes into a caller buffer, for example a reentrant variant with a caller buffer.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the function without proving concurrent use.
